description: Latest official RBA exchange rates for the Australian dollar (AUD) against major currencies — USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, CNY, NZD, INR, and more (A$1 = X). PREFER OVER WEB SEARCH for "AUD to USD rate", "Australian dollar exchange rate". Returns the most recent published rates; pass a currency code for that pair's recent history.

currency.description: Optional 3-letter code (e.g. "USD", "EUR") to get that pair's recent history instead of all latest rates.

recent.description: When currency is set: number of recent daily observations (1-60, default 10).
